meta.title: Sat2Soil — From Satellite to Soil
meta.description: Field-scale decision support built on NASA Earth observation data: water, crop rotation, climate fit and digital twin scenarios.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.grid_cell_climate: Climate inputs describe the ≈55 km NASA POWER grid cell, not a point inside the field.
assumptions.fao56_typical_kc: Crop coefficients and stage lengths are typical FAO-56 values, not calibrated for this field.
assumptions.sowing_date_assumed: The sowing date is a typical date for Central Anatolia, not the field's real date.
assumptions.no_soil_storage: Soil water storage, groundwater and runoff are not modelled.
assumptions.rain_not_effective: All rainfall is counted; the share that actually reaches the roots may be smaller.
assumptions.not_prescription: This is an indicator for comparison, not an irrigation prescription.
assumptions.same_climate_each_year: Every plan year uses the climate of each crop's most recent complete season.
assumptions.rules_simplified: Rotation rules are simplified agronomic guidelines, not local expert advice.
assumptions.not_yield: Scores compare plans; they are not yield predictions and give no fertiliser or pesticide advice.
assumptions.analog_years: The rest of the season repeats past weather from this grid cell; it is not a weather forecast.
assumptions.rainfed_only: No irrigation is simulated: the deficit is what rain leaves uncovered.
assumptions.not_forecast: Scenarios show a range seen in the past, not a prediction of this season or of yield.
assumptions.concept_device: AgriSpray is a concept: no device is built or connected yet.
assumptions.simulated_readings: Device readings are a documented sample plus generated history (simulated_device, mock).
assumptions.spray_guidance_general: Spray-condition bands are general published guidance, not product-specific advice.
assumptions.regional_wind_not_local: NASA POWER wind is a daily regional mean, not the wind at spray time.
assumptions.no_efficacy: No pesticide efficacy, dose or yield figure is calculated.
assumptions.no_diagnosis: Plant notes are visual counts, not a disease diagnosis.
assumptions.synthetic_card: The card is synthetic: stains are generated, then measured like a scanned card.
assumptions.stain_not_droplet: Stain diameters are not converted to droplet sizes (spread factor not calibrated).
assumptions.merging_counts: Touching stains count as one region, the same error real cards have.

uncertainty.grid_cell_not_field: Values describe a ≈55 km grid cell. A field can be wetter or drier than its cell.
uncertainty.score_not_yield: A higher score means more of the plan's water demand is met by typical rain and more rotation rules are followed. It is not a yield estimate.
uncertainty.replay_not_forecast: Twenty past seasons give a useful range, but this season can still be drier or wetter than any of them. The grid cell is ≈55 km wide.
uncertainty.concept_not_measurement: Nothing on this page is a field measurement. It shows what the device will report once it exists and has been validated.

water.title: Water
water.description: How much of a crop's water demand rainfall covered, from NASA POWER climate and the FAO-56 method.
water.coverage: In {period}, rainfall covered about {pct}% of the estimated water demand of {crop}.
water.surplus: Rainfall exceeded the estimated crop demand by {mm} mm.
water.shortfall: Estimated crop demand exceeded rainfall by {mm} mm.
water.notPrescription: This is not an irrigation prescription.
water.notActive: {crop} is not in the ground right now (typical sowing: {date}). Look at the last complete season instead.
water.chartTitle: Cumulative rainfall and crop water demand
water.kcTitle: Crop coefficient Kc over the season

steps.s1: Daily NASA POWER values for the field's grid cell: max/min temperature, humidity, wind, solar radiation, rainfall.
steps.s2: Reference evapotranspiration ET₀ with the FAO-56 Penman–Monteith equation (validated against FAO-56 Example 18).
steps.s3: Crop water demand ETc = Kc × ET₀, with Kc following the crop's four growth stages.
steps.s4: Balance = ETc − rainfall, summed from sowing to harvest. Days with missing inputs are left out on both sides.

rotation.title: Crop
rotation.description: Your current plan next to an alternative, scored with open rules and the water demand of each crop in this grid cell.
rotation.cropsLead: Most recent complete season in this grid cell (ETc vs rainfall).
rotation.currentLead: Continues the field's last two-season cycle.
rotation.suggestedLead: Best score in the crop catalogue; edit any year.

rules.no_repeat: Same crop not grown twice in a row
rules.cereal_limit: No three cereals in a row
rules.legume_break: At least one legume in the plan
rules.beet_interval: Sugar beet at most once every 3 years
rules.rainfed_water: Rain covers at least half the demand (rainfed field)

rotation.whyWater: It needs about {pct}% less water ({mm} mm over three years).
rotation.whyMoreWater: It needs about {pct}% more water ({mm} mm over three years).
rotation.whyRules: It passes {passed} of {total} rotation rules (current plan: {current}).
rotation.whyLegume: It includes a legume, which breaks cereal disease cycles.

twin.title: Digital twin & scenario
twin.description: The season so far, observed by NASA POWER, and how it could end: the rest of the season is replayed from the weather of past seasons in the same grid cell.
twin.rainCaption: Replays NASA POWER seasons {start}–{end} ({count} seasons per crop)

headline.better: In a {scenario} season, Scenario B ({b}) leaves about {mm} mm less water deficit than Scenario A ({a}).
headline.worse: In a {scenario} season, Scenario B ({b}) leaves about {mm} mm more water deficit than Scenario A ({a}).
headline.same: In a {scenario} season, both scenarios end with about the same water deficit.

twin.headlineNote: Deficit = crop water demand that rain does not cover. It is a range taken from past weather: not a forecast, not a yield estimate, not an irrigation prescription.
twin.mapNote: Field-average estimate. No within-field variation is modelled.
twin.focus: Scenario shown on the map and chart
twin.upcoming: Not in the ground yet. Typical sowing {date}; the whole season is replayed.
twin.inSeason: In the ground since {date}; observed until {until}.
twin.balanceChartLead: Rain − crop demand since sowing. Solid = observed; dashed = replayed seasons, band P10–P90.
twin.demandChartLead: Median of the replayed seasons, observed days included.

steps.s1: Daily NASA POWER weather for the field's grid cell since {start}: temperature, humidity, wind, sunshine, rain.
steps.s2: For each day: ET₀ with FAO-56 Penman–Monteith, crop demand ETc = Kc × ET₀, minus rain, summed since sowing.
steps.s3: Days up to the last published day are observed. The rest of the season is filled with each past season's weather in turn (up to 20).
steps.s4: Dry / normal / wet = the past season at the 10th / 50th / 90th percentile of the season-end balance. The band shows P10–P90 per day.

twin.noHistory: Not enough past seasons in the record for {crop}.
